title: Playboy July 1983 Bond's Women Carrie Fisher Earl Weaver Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, July 1983, original $3.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Saving Bond's Women - a loving look at 007's sultriest co-stars; Playboy Interview with baseball's rowdy genius Earl Weaver; Albert Brooks, the funniest white man in America; John Sack reports on life among the nerds at computer camp; Carrie Fisher answers 20 Questions.

Back cover: Smirnoff vodka ad with Robert Ludlum.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
